remarks: Experience a sophisticated carefree lifestyle at sought after Jelliff Mill Falls. Designed by Judy Larson & built by Gardiner Group renown for quality construction, special architectural details & luxurious finishes.  There is no condo of this caliber that compares. This particular unit is unique and offers direct water views of the Noroton River & magical waterfall. Experience an elegant blend of classic comfort and modern amenities in this stunning waterfront home. From the high ceilings, wide-plank flooring, custom features throughout, no detail has been overlooked in the creation of this bespoke abode. The kitchen on the main level is a chef's dream with waterfall island with seating, top-of-the-line appliances paired with sleek cabinetry, Waterworks fixtures, two sinks and oversized walk-in-pantry. The open concept layout family room/kitchen/ dining room provides access out to the waterfront terrace equipped with awning. A chic office could double for a living room. The primary suite is plush with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, walk-in closets and marble bathroom. A guest bedroom with ensuite bath, 2nd floor laundry room, and large bonus space is currently used as a second office space & reading nook. On the walk out lower level, there is an additional en suite guest bedroom, plentiful amounts of storage and a warm and inviting family room with fireplace. Elevator capacity & tons of storage. Almost every room enjoys glistening views overlooking Jelliff Pond waterfall.
